issues: All four panels were grey skeleton wireframes — no paused frame told you what page or feature it was
Light grey background with blue-grey pills: everything looked washed out and unlit, and the pill gloss was a hard-edged rectangle
Pill labels were Feature A–D placeholders, and with everything authored in 480×270 design units the text was too small to read
The corridor had only scale and sink, no depth; swaps were a rigid translation with no sense of speed
The cursor just slid into place and stopped, and centred panels never moved, so the holds were dead frames
changes: Aurora dark stage (violet-pink key light, horizon band, violet floor glow, dust); panels are hue-tinted dark glass with hairline edges, a lit top edge and two-layer deep shadows, laid out natively at 1920 without DesignStage

Pills rebuilt as candy glass: four-stop violet gradient, pink bounce light, an elliptical highlight clipped to the radius, and an icon; the centred pill glows and spills violet light onto its panel's top edge, and pills float gently

Content is now four feature screens of a fictional product, Halo (Compose / Insights / Automate / Publish), one key message each with readable text ≥30px; each panel's hero element performs a small action when centred (typing, count-up + chart draw, pulse along the workflow, toggle on)
Corridor depth: neighbours scale to 0.62, sink 120px, turn outward 16°, dim 50% and blur 2.2px; swaps get velocity-based horizontal motion blur and the pills settle about 2f after the panels

Rhythm accelerates through the tour: beats of 26f (with long tail) / 20f / 18f, holds 16f → 12f; the cursor pops in, glides to the last pill, clicks (5% press + spring back) and triggers a single sheen; slow push throughout; duration 120→168f
